title: Grow a list
summary: Rust: Grow a list. Push 9 as well. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A Vec stores values in order. push adds a value at the end. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install stable Rust. Save each example as lesson.rs, run rustc lesson.rs, then run the created program.

blocks.title: Grow a list

blocks.text: vec! creates the vector. push adds 8; {:?} requests a list-style display.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The vector must be mutable to push a new item.
